text:
maria: quick alignment thread 3 customer-driven asks: stable egress IPs for firewall allowlists, and upgrades that don't trigger support escalations. proposing a small Q2 slice to ship an opt-in preserve-egress flow + an upgrade canary pattern.
chetan: scope breakdown please.
maria: high level: 1) installer handshake + audit event for customer-managed networking; 2) runtime SNAT-preserve mode to keep node egress IPs across restarts; 3) operator canary + rollback for in-place upgrades; 4) pilot runbook and fast support lane.
olivia: field signals: two regulated customers require egress pinning; one said it's a blocker for go-live. we should prioritize docs/samples alongside code.
chetan: rough engineering estimates: handshake API & UX 2w; SNAT-preserve spike+MVP 3-4w; operator canary automation 4-6w. tests + runbook parallel.
maria: MVS suggestion:
- Handshake: installer accepts --preserve-egress flag and emits /var/lib/redwood/handshake.json; integration test with netops mock.
- SNAT-preserve: external echo service verification that outbound IP stays identical across node reboot and operator upgrade.
- Canary upgrades: staged rollout controller (10/50/100) + health gates and automated rollback.
- Security: Sec review required before pilot.
ols: build-bot: CI packaging-e2e failing on operator-canary with CRD migrate timeout: https://ci.internal/packaging-e2e/2011
chetan: risks: CNI variance (Calico vs Cilium), NAT gateway pools causing multiple egress IPs, CRD compatibility. mitigation: run shim tests across CNIs and add an adapter for schema changes.
maria: prioritization vote: P0 preserve-egress + runbook; P1 rolling-canary; P2 proxy shim fallback; P3 bgp/autoconfig. any objections?
olivia: +1 P0. we'll offer pilot support credits to early customers.
chetan: I'll own SNAT RFC + initial impl. olivia will lead runbook & pilot coordination. target: internal pilot in 5 weeks.
build-bot: Note: packaging-e2e scheduled daily on preserve-egress branch until pilot.
maria: action items recap: chetan: RFC & plan (due in 5d); olivia: runbook + pilot outreach (due in 7d); maria: add roadmap card + schedule 30m sync next Thu.
